C_honest_chain_verifies.fails_if: the honest chain does not reproduce its own heads -- then every rejection below is vacuous

C_regrouping_detected.fails_if: two epoch groupings of one atom set share a chain head -- the chain would add nothing to the root, which S73 already showed is grouping-blind
C_regrouping_detected.can_fail: head_a == head_b, or root_a != root_b (which would mean the groupings were not equivalent in state and the test is void)

C_reorder_detected.fails_if: swapping two epochs leaves the chain head unchanged -- order would not be committed

C_dropped_epoch_detected.fails_if: dropping an epoch leaves the chain head unchanged

C_split_epoch_detected.fails_if: splitting one epoch in two leaves the head unchanged -- a prover could inflate its epoch count for free

C_delta_content_bound.fails_if: substituting one atom inside a delta, at identical size and identical roots, leaves the head unchanged -- the chain would bind shape, not content (S65)
C_delta_content_bound.can_fail: the recomputed head equals the honest head

C_replayed_epoch_rejected.fails_if: an epoch's (root, delta) pair verifies at a different position -- epochs would be transplantable
C_replayed_epoch_rejected.can_fail: verify_chain returns True on the transplanted sequence

C_chain_alone_cannot_catch_a_forged_delt.fails_if: the chain alone rejects a root its declared delta does not produce -- then it would subsume S73 and this boundary claim is wrong. Also fails if the fold does not reproduce the honest root, which would make the comparison vacuous
C_chain_alone_cannot_catch_a_forged_delt.can_fail: chain_ok reads false, or folded != honest3 (broken fold, control void), or folded == the lied root
